targets.rawSql: SELECT origin, event, count(*) AS delivered_events FROM dashboard_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) GROUP BY origin, event
SELECT origin, stream, tool, sum(calls) AS delivered_calls FROM dashboard_tools WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) GROUP BY origin, stream, tool
SELECT origin, version_bucket, os_bucket, count(*) AS delivered_events FROM dashboard_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) GROUP BY origin, version_bucket, os_bucket

panels.title: Arrival lag p95 seconds (receipt-bearing events only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT origin, date_trunc('day', received_at) AS received_day, count(*) AS received_events, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (received_at-event_at))) AS p95_lag_seconds FROM dashboard_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND event_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY origin, received_day
